(Sharh at-Tibi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ لِأَبِي مُوسَي: لَوْ رَأَيْتَنِي وَانَا أَسْتَمِعُ قِرَاءَتَكَ الْبَارِحَةَ لَقَدْ أُوتِيتَ مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب استحباب تحسين الصوت بالقران رقم:١٨٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “If you had seen me listening attentively while you were reciting the Qur'an last night (you would certainly have been pleased). You have been given a share of the sweet voice of Dawud (AS).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يُقَالُ يَعْنِي لِصَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ اِقْرَأْ وَارْقَ وَرَتِّلْ كَمَا كُنْتَ تُرَتِّلُ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَإِنَّ مَنْزِلَتَكَ عِنْدَ آخِرِ آيَةٍ تَقْرَأُ بِهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ان الذي ليس في جوفه من القران ...رقم:٢٩١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: “(On the Day of Qiyamah) it will be said to the companion of the Qur'an, “Keep reciting the noble Qur'an! Keep climbing the levels of Jannah! Just as you used to recite in the world, pausing and pausing, recite here too with pauses! Your dwelling is the place where you finish reciting the last ayah.””

blocks.text:
Explanation: The companion of the Qur'an means a Hafiz who has memorised the Qur'an, or one who recites the Qur'an abundantly, or one who reflects on the Qur'an and acts upon it.
(Tibi, Mirqat)
